title: M100 real out-of-memory diagnosis
query_text: My job 66353 died on node r5n3 and SLURM says it failed. What happened, and how do I stop it happening again?

eval_criteria.gold_answer: Job 66353 on node r5n3 was killed by the out-of-memory (OOM) handler: SLURM classified it OUT_OF_MEMORY. The ganglia mem_free on r5n3 falls steeply toward zero — against a much larger mem_total — in the period before the kill, confirming the node ran out of memory, after which total_power drops to idle as the process died. This is a memory-exhaustion failure, not a node hardware fault (idle power is normal afterward). To prevent it: reduce the job's per-task memory footprint or batch size, request more memory (--mem) or a high-memory node, or place fewer tasks per node.
